incident: SQL free allowance exhausted; AutoPause stopped the database

events.normal: dispatch after successful commit on create/payment/cancel
events.failure: preserve committed result and pending Outbox event
events.delivery: at least once; consumer deduplicates eventId

limitations: Cost reduction and SQL inactivity pause have not yet been measured over a full idle cycle.
Recovery timer can still wake SQL and consume student credits.
Cold starts may add latency; warm the application before presentation.
Earlier PDF/video guide describes the old two-minute Timer; present post-commit dispatch and two-hour recovery instead.
